schema: components[name] = {route, selector (root), children (key descendant selectors; "doc:" = anywhere in the document), states[stateName][`${theme}-${width}`] = {root: {property: computed value, ..., size: "WxH" (bounding box, px)}, children: {selector: {...} | null when absent}}, anchor_offset?[stateName][context] = {panel_size, anchor_size, top_left: {dx, dy}, top_right: {dx, dy}} | {absent, reason}, note?}. Touch widths emulate a phone ((hover:none) and (pointer:coarse) match, verified per capture). Every capture uses the demo-off and host-mode params. States are forced with CDP CSS.forcePseudoState, attribute/class toggles, page code, scrolling or real clicks; values are read after the state wait (default 450 ms) with finite animations finished; a record with animated: "infinite" has a property driven by an endless animation, recorded paused at currentTime 0. Which contexts exist and which properties a context records: see scope.

Sidebar.note: Persistent shell, owned by the app-shell FRD. Phone: an off-canvas drawer.
